name: Pending Identity Status
summary: Describes the lifecycle of the secure identity-resolution airlock before durable identity resolution.

values.name: Pending
values.summary: The identity ceremony is active and awaiting its next valid action.

values.name: Verification Required
values.summary: Additional identity proof is required before resolution.

values.name: Verifying
values.summary: A verification operation is in progress.

values.name: Resolution Required
values.summary: Credential proof exists but create, link, or reject resolution remains.

values.name: Resolved
values.summary: The pending identity has resolved to a durable identity.

values.name: Expired
values.summary: The pending identity is no longer usable.

values.name: Failed
values.summary: The ceremony ended in a terminal failure.
